Anomalous Veles Detector

%c[0,224,224,224]An old, broken and seemingly anomalous Veles detector, its circuitry warped and fused with traces of unknown artefact matter. 
The device emits a faint, rhythmic hum, seemingly in tune with the background radiation of the Zone. When active, it slowly siphons residual radiation from the user’s body — a process that feels like a low electric pulse running beneath the skin. Whether a placebo or not, those who encountered this anomalous device swore that it made them feel sated, possibly due to harmonious effect of absorbing radiation and turning it into energy for the user’s body.
However, this comes at a cost: the detector’s shielding has degraded, exposing the operator to increased ambient radiation levels.
 
While invaluable for those frequently wandering through contaminated areas or psy-active zones, the device’s unstable radiation feedback makes prolonged use a dangerous gamble.
